title: Flows of geometric structures II
summary: We advance the general theory of flows of tensorial $\mathrm{H}$-structures, focusing on non-isometric flows and on the case $\mathrm{H}=\mathrm{SU}(m)\subset\mathrm{SO}(2m)$. After developing the relevant $\mathrm{SU}(m)$ algebra, we compare two natural evolutions: the unrestricted negative gradient flow of the intrinsic-torsion energy and a Ricci-harmonic flow. We prove short-time existence and uniqueness for the Ricci-harmonic $\mathrm{H}$-flow, with arbitrary lower-order torsion-quadratic terms, for every closed subgroup $\mathrm{H}\subset\mathrm{SO}(n)$.
